author: eee29923
quote: They’re hyping it up as the eighth wonder of the world, when in reality it’s just unfunny, "woke" propaganda. It’s the exact same thing as GTA V—there’s no difference. The story is mediocre, and the gameplay is just as lackluster; they’ve focused solely on making it more realistic just for the sake of marketing. We waited through 13 years of development, only for them to deliver a poorly put-together piece of crap that runs at a "stable" 30 fps and is riddled with bugs. The truth is, this game is nothing more than a commercial scam. It’s obvious that Rockstar bought off the critics, and I have no doubt they’ll do the same for the Game Awards. The only redeeming quality is the graphics; beyond that, it’s just the same old trash—a criminal simulator.
